name: Front deck shell
note: Main body. Holds the water tank, mist nozzle, guard fans and holo ring. Front window shows the water level.
print: Print upside down (top face on the bed), no supports except the front window bridge.

name: Bottom plate
note: Closes the deck. Screws in with five M3 screws; rubber feet sit in recesses. Lift it off to reach the tank drain.

name: Water tank (about 1 litre)
note: Holds about 0.9 L of distilled water. The 24 V mister disc sits in the round cradle, the float switch cuts power if it runs low.
print: Print upright, 4 walls, 100% top and bottom for watertightness. Seal inside with a coat of food-safe epoxy if it weeps.

name: Tank lid and mist chamber
note: Seals the tank. A 40 mm fan blows air into the tank so the fog rises out of the long outlet into the nozzle. Has the fill cap, drip return spigot and cable gland.

name: Slot nozzle
note: Turns the fog into a thin flat sheet: a 130 x 8 mm mist slot with a 5 mm guard-air slot each side, which keep the sheet straight so her image stays sharp.
print: Print upright. Fine 0.12 mm layers on the slot lips.

name: Honeycomb straightener
note: Thousands of 3 mm hex tubes that calm the air so the mist leaves as a smooth sheet (it replaces the drinking straws). Drops into the top of the nozzle.

name: Guard fan housings and ducts (pair)
note: Each holds a quiet 40 mm fan behind the side grille and channels its air into the nozzle's guard slots.

name: Holo ring diffuser
note: Glows from the LED strip (26 addressable LEDs) sitting in the channel underneath. It pulses with her voice and shifts colour with her mood.

name: Holo ring cover
note: Forge-style emitter ring she stands on: twelve light windows over the diffuser and raised outer lip, like a desk-size version of her in-game hologram pad.

name: Rear emitter tower
note: Holds the projector standing lens-up and the angled mirror behind a glass window. The light leaves the sloped front face and crosses the mist sheet from behind, so you never look into the lens.
print: Print upright. The slope needs no supports.

name: Projector cradle
note: Adjustable sled for the projector, standing lens-up. Velcro straps through the side windows; the slots let it slide to centre the image. Sized for the Optoma ML1050STi (112 x 123 x 57 mm) standing lens-up, turned sideways so her image comes out portrait, with end stops so it cannot slide.

name: Tilting mirror mount
note: Holds a 60 x 50 mm front-surface mirror at 45 degrees with a thumb-screw for about plus or minus 10 degrees of tilt, so the image can be aimed up or down the mist sheet.

name: Electronics trays
note: Two slim trays either side of the projector. Left: ESP32 (or Pico W) and a compact 4-channel MOSFET board, one behind the other. Right: the 24 V to 12 V and 5 V step-down converters. Cooled through the tower louvres.

name: Rear port panel
note: HDMI in, USB-C (control link to her box), 24 V power socket and a rocker switch, plus vents.

name: Spine and cap arm
note: Carries the collector cap over her head. Hollow inside for the drip-return tube and the cap's fan and Peltier wires; the front groove holds a thin LED line.
print: Print lying on its side. Optional 10 mm aluminium tube inside for stiffness.

name: Collector cap
note: Sits over her head and catches the rising mist. A 60 mm fan pulls it in over a Peltier-cooled plate; the condensed water drips into the tray and runs back down the spine to the tank.

name: Cold plate and drip tray
note: Carries the aluminium cold plate (Peltier TEC1-12706 underneath, heatsink above). Its gutter collects the drips and feeds the return tube.

name: Optoma ML1050STi projector
note: 0.8 throw, 535 ANSI lumens, 112 x 123 x 57 mm, about 0.4 kg. Stands lens-up; the mirror turns its light forward through the window.

name: Front-surface mirror 60 x 50 mm
note: Avoids the double image a normal mirror gives.

name: 40 mm fans (x3)
note: Two guard fans plus the tank air fan. Quiet 12 V (Noctua NF-A4x10 class).

name: 24 V ultrasonic mister
note: Sits in the tank cradle.

name: 60 mm fan, Peltier and cold plate
note: Collector hardware.

name: Clear window, 124 x 64 mm
note: Keeps mist off the mirror and projector. 2 mm acrylic or glass.

name: Her image on the mist sheet (25 cm)
note: A flat stand-in silhouette showing where her projected image appears. Her real model never goes into these files.

name: Mist sheet
note: The thin curtain of fog (shown as a pane).
